network_bring_up_sequence.description: ESC enters Init; reads SII EEPROM into internal registers (auto-load) or via SII Control/Status.
BRD to 0x0130 (AL Status) and BRD to 0x0010 (Configured Station Address) — sweep returns total SubDevice count via WKC; addresses are 0x0000 (unassigned) at this point.
APRD to 0x0000 with Position=0 reads first SubDevice's Type/Revision/Build; APRD with incrementing Position reads each subsequent SubDevice.
APWR to 0x0010 with Position=0..N-1 sets a unique 16-bit FP address on each SubDevice.
Per SubDevice: FPWR 0x0501 to take ECAT ownership of EEPROM, then sequence of FPWR/FPRD 0x0502/0x0504/0x0508 to read ESI.
FPWR 0x0800 (SM0 — Mailbox Out) and 0x0808 (SM1 — Mailbox In) with sizes / addresses / control bits per the ESI's default mailbox config.
Optional, if DC required: BWR to 0x0900 latches all RX timestamps; FPRD sweeps timestamps; MainDevice computes propagation delays.
FPWR 0x0120 = 0x02 per SubDevice; BRD 0x0130 verifies all in PreOp.
FPWR 0x0810 (SM2 — Outputs), 0x0818 (SM3 — Inputs), 0x0600+ (FMMU0..2 mapping process data into logical address space). Configure DC SYNC0/SYNC1 cycle + start time.
FPWR 0x0120 = 0x04; SubDevice validates SM2/SM3/FMMU. If invalid → AL Status = 0x14 + AL Status Code. If valid → AL Status = 0x04.
Start cyclic LRD/LWR/LRW; observe Inputs valid; outputs still in Safe state on SubDevice hardware.
FPWR 0x0120 = 0x08; SubDevice arms PD WD and drives application outputs from process data. AL Status = 0x08.
Repeated forever: cyclic LRD/LWR/LRW + periodic ARMW (DC) + periodic BRD 0x0130 (diagnostic). On WKC drop or AL Status change → enter ERROR_HANDLING.

cyclic_frame_transmission_sequence.description: Construct Ethernet frame: DA + SA + EtherType=0x88A4 + EtherCAT_Header(Len, Type=0x1) + chained datagrams (e.g. one LRW for process data, optional ARMW for DC, optional BRD for diagnostic). Compute initial WKC=0 per datagram. Append FCS.
Transmit frame onto Port 0 wire toward first SubDevice.

Receive frame, decode datagram. If addressed (LRW with FMMU mapping covering this SubDevice's logical region): on-the-fly read from local DPRAM into the Data field for Read, write incoming Data bytes into local DPRAM for Write, update WKC (+3). Forward modified frame on Port 1.
Same as step 3 — each addressed SubDevice contributes its part.
Last SubDevice has no link on Port 1 — ESC hardware loops frame back.
Each return-side ESC passes the frame transparently (already-modified bytes are stable; no second WKC increment).
Receive returning frame; per-datagram WKC = expected total. MainDevice extracts Inputs from frame; verifies WKC; updates application state.

mailbox_communication_sequence_coe_sdo_r.description: Construct CoE SDO Read Request: Mbx_Header(Length=10, Address=0, Channel=0, Priority=0, Type=0x03 CoE, Counter++) + CoE Header(Number=0, Service=0x02 SDO Request) + SDO Command(0x40 Init Upload Request) + Index(2B) + Subindex(1B) + Reserved(4B).
FPWR 0x1000 (SM0 mailbox base) with the constructed mailbox message; SM0 hardware sets Mbx_Out Empty=1 to signal the SubDevice CPU.

Interrupt or polling detects SM0 message arrived; reads SM0 via PDI; parses CoE SDO Read Request; looks up Object Dictionary entry at Index/Subindex; constructs SDO Response (Init Upload Response or Init Upload Segment Response).
Writes response into SM1 mailbox via PDI; hardware sets Mbx_In Full=1.
Polls SM1 status via FPRD 0x080D; on Mbx_In Full=1, FPRD 0x1400 reads response; parses CoE SDO Response; returns Object Dictionary value to application.

distributed_clock_propagation_sequence.description: Configure DC: BWR 0x0980 (Cyclic Unit Control), BWR 0x0981 (Activation), per-SubDevice FPWR 0x0990 (Sync0 Cycle Time), 0x0994 (Sync1 Cycle Time), 0x09A0 (Sync Start Time).
Per cycle: ARMW (Cmd 0x0D) datagram with Position=0 (reference SubDevice). Address = 0x0910 (System Time). Length = 8.
ESC writes its local System Time into the frame's Data field; WKC += 1.
Each DC-capable SubDevice reads the Data field, computes (received_System_Time + System_Time_Delay - local_System_Time) error, updates local System Time Offset (0x0920) via internal PLL/PI loop.
SYNC0 / SYNC1 output pulses align to local System Time; jitter across hops < 100 ns.

hot_connect_join_sequence.description: New device powered on, link-up on its Port 0; ESC reads SII; AL Status = 0x01 (Init).
Adjacent SubDevice's port hardware detects new link; auto-loopback opens; frame now passes through new SubDevice as well.
Next BRD 0x0130 sweep shows one extra SubDevice (WKC++); MainDevice detects Hot Connect.
APWR Configured Station Address; FPWR SM/FMMU/DC config; ESM Init → PreOp → SafeOp → Op.
Hot Connect group's process data joins the cyclic exchange.

cable_break_recovery_sequence_ring.description: MainDevice runs ring topology with two NICs. Both NICs send cyclic frames in opposite directions.
Cable break detected by ESC on affected port; auto-loopback closes the port.
Ring now splits into two healthy line segments; each MainDevice NIC reaches half the SubDevices via its primary direction.
Detects topology change via DL Status read; cyclic exchange continues without SubDevice loss.
